primary_sources.title: Algorithm selection by rational metareasoning as a model of human strategy selection
primary_sources.collision: Value-of-computation/rational strategy selection is established; generic metareasoning is not novel.

primary_sources.title: Value-Directed Belief State Approximation for POMDPs
primary_sources.collision: Belief approximation judged by decision/utility error rather than state reconstruction is established; epistemic fidelity need not equal decision fidelity.

primary_sources.title: Value-Directed Sampling Methods for POMDPs
primary_sources.collision: Adaptive effort can be directed to distinguish policies while meeting decision-error bounds.

primary_sources.title: No Compromise in Solution Quality: Speeding Up Belief-dependent Continuous POMDPs via Adaptive Multilevel Simplification
primary_sources.collision: Adaptive bounds can provably return the same optimal action as the unsimplified planner; action-preserving simplification is known.

primary_sources.title: Open-loop POMDP Simplification and Safe Skipping of Replanning with Formal Performance Guarantees
primary_sources.collision: Safely skipping replanning while preserving action/performance is close functional prior art.

primary_sources.title: Teaching LLMs When to Stop Seeking and Start Acting
primary_sources.collision: LLM-specific termination/stop-seeking is active prior art; generic stop-thinking novelty collapses.

primary_sources.title: Statistical Early Stopping for Reasoning Models
primary_sources.collision: Uncertainty-aware/statistically controlled early stopping is known; confidence/risk stopping is not novel.

destruction_result: Broad claims of adaptive stopping, value-directed uncertainty reduction, policy-preserving simplification, and stop-seeking are known. IAC may only survive as a Frank-specific exact support/action semantic contract and test law.
